title: Practice 5: вз- (вс-): up — на-: onto, and a quantity covered

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Я ___ (навести / наводить — to introduce, bring, produce, make, cause) на вас тоску.

exercises.context: навести́** — **наводи́ть — to direct (at), to aim (at), to point (at); to cover, to coat, to apply.

exercises.q: Теперь в крепость ___ (набежать / набегать — to run, to dash) даже больше пяти тысяч.
